title: Transit daemon: peering, store-and-forward, pinning, GC, metrics, operator CLI
description: Implement the usenet-ipfs-transit binary. Accepts NNTP peering connections (IHAVE/TAKETHIS), stores articles to IPFS, appends to group log, propagates over gossipsub. Operator configures pinning policy and GC schedule. Prometheus metrics and an operator CLI (status, pin, unpin, gc-run, peer-list) are included.
